text:
maria: Quick thread — trying to land the 'speed vs spend' narrative for next week's benchmark post + webinar. Goal: show how Redwood reduces per-token cost while keeping 95th%-latency under acceptable SLOs. Need: one hero chart, 2 supporting visuals, headline options, and inbound routing for demo requests.

devin: Can you share the numbers we plan to show? rough is fine.

maria: Pasting the sample table I used in the deck:

```
model,95th_latency_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens
redwood-v1-7b,120,0.22
redwood-quant-7b,150,0.10
open-7b,250,0.18
open-13b,320,0.35
```

maria: Hero idea: dual-axis line — latency (left, ms) and cost (right, $ per 1k tokens) across model variants. callout dots for 'dedicated' vs 'hosted'.

leo: Headlines (short):
- "Faster responses, lower token bills: what we measured"
- "Speed vs Spend: tuning inference for production"
- "Keep latency, cut costs — a practitioner’s map"

sam: Love the dual-axis but keep it simple for social. For webinar demo we should animate a 'before/after' with batching + prefix cache turned on.

rachel: Inbound routing: prefer form -> HubSpot lead with fields: company, role, use-case, region, expected qps. Add hidden utm fields. If signal is high (company size > 500 or qps>100), auto-route to AE queue. Low-touch leads get the on-demand demo link.

maria: Agree. Also want a short post-demo survey question: "Which constraint matters most? latency / cost / reliability" — tag responses to eval owners.

marketing-bot: Figma frames uploaded: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/perf-storyboard :frame=hero

devin: A/B subject lines for webinar invite:
A) "Live: Cut inference costs without sacrificing speed"
B) "How we balanced latency and dollars for production LLMs"

leo: Visual asks for the designer:
- hero: dual-axis line, point labels for 95th latency
- inset: bar showing tokens-to-dollars breakdown (stacked by batching effect)
- CTA: "Request a demo" + small "See reproducible script" link

sam: Ops note: include a short reproducible snippet in the public repo and the slide deck. People love step-by-step.

maria: Can someone own the hero viz and the copy by EOD Friday? cc @leo @devin

leo: I'll take the viz, can deliver wireframe by Thu.

devin: I'll batch headline copy + email cadence. expect first drafts tomorrow.

rachel: I'll map hidden fields + AE routing logic and post the HubSpot flow.

maria: Perfect. Thanks everyone. We'll sync Thu 9am to review assets. :tada:
